findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ontario_list-service, ontario_refresh-listing · Private data: ontario_purchase_router, ontario_task_fit, find_x402_tool, ontario_list-service · Public sink: ontario_list-service, ontario_list-agent · Destructive: find_x402_tool, ontario_list-service, ontario_refresh-listing, ontario_list-agent.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ontario_list-service, ontario_refresh-listing · Private data: ontario_purchase_router, ontario_task_fit, find_x402_tool, ontario_list-service · Public sink: ontario_list-service, ontario_list-agent · Destructive: find_x402_tool, ontario_list-service, ontario_refresh-listing, ontario_list-agent

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "ontario_purchase_router" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
